text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To think such an incredible performer was 
so close by...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Because just now, you 
gave me dreams and hope.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you work hard, you'll master special 
techniques! Nothing in this world is 
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you for showing me the 
road!
